notes: EVERY BUTTON: a full end-to-end audit of every control in the game - keyboard, gamepad, both touch schemes, mouse - across the meadow, the Mall, the Arcade and every cabinet. DRAG players are no longer trapped in the Mall, the Bug Bowl lanes answer taps, cabinet menus walk the way you press, Settings key-capture can be cancelled from any device, and prompts across the game name the button actually in your hands. No new features; nothing got harder or easier.
